claim: A model probability or thresholded crop map is a candidate product, not a verified field-area boundary; defensible map accuracy and area estimation require reference labels and an assessment design consistent with the intended estimand.
conditions: Internal spatial holdout can estimate model performance under its split design but does not become independent field validation unless the reference sample was independently designed and collected.
limitations: Manual review can improve boundaries but is not a substitute for probability-sample accuracy assessment when unbiased regional area estimates are required.
recommended_action: Export probability and candidate layers, report class-specific precision and recall, review boundaries, and approve a separate roi_field_area before sample design.
not_allowed_action: Do not automatically pass an unreviewed candidate map into cLHS or report pixel-count area as error-adjusted crop area.
